name: Jackie Chan
role: Hong Kong actor and filmmaker; member of the CPPCC National Committee (2013-2023)
summary: Chan is an entertainer rather than a political figure. He has made occasional public remarks supportive of the Chinese government and critical of protest in Hong Kong, but these are mostly patriotic statements and loose remarks that do not address the specific statements of this test.
